topic: Choose a weekend trip for friends where one person wants quiet and one wants something active

scenario.topic: Choose a weekend trip for friends where one person wants quiet and one wants something active
scenario.opening_question: How should we balance relaxation and activity for our weekend trip?

options.name: Cabin Retreat at Lake Serenity
options.upside: Peaceful lakeside setting ideal for quiet and relaxation
options.tradeoff: Limited active options, mostly light hiking and fishing
options.concern: May feel too slow or boring for those wanting vigorous activity

options.name: Mountain Biking at Pine Ridge Trails
options.upside: Extensive biking trails provide a strong active experience
options.tradeoff: Noisy and less private lodging, limited quiet downtime
options.concern: Not suitable for those wanting calm or minimal physical exertion

options.name: Historic Town Stay in Willow Creek
options.upside: Charming town with museums, cafes, and light walking tours
options.tradeoff: Less intense physical activity, some noise from town center
options.concern: May not satisfy those wanting vigorous outdoor exercise or full quiet
options.best_for: balanced mix of quiet and light activity

options.name: Beachside Yoga and Surf Camp
options.upside: Combines relaxing yoga sessions with active surfing lessons
options.tradeoff: Longer travel time and shared lodging reduce privacy
options.concern: May be too physically demanding or social for some
options.best_for: mix of active and mindful relaxation
